description: Publish videos to a connected TikTok creator account

actions.description: Publish a video to the connected TikTok creator account. The video must be no longer than the connection's cached maxVideoPostDurationSec, and privacy_level must be one of its cached privacyLevelOptions. While the app is pending TikTok's content-posting audit, TikTok forces every post to SELF_ONLY and allows at most 5 posting users per 24 hours.

params.asset_id: Id of the recorded video asset to publish (required unless video_url is given)
params.video_url: Publicly reachable URL TikTok should pull the video from, as an alternative to asset_id (optional)
params.title: Caption shown on the post, including any hashtags or @mentions (optional)
params.privacy_level: Post visibility — one of the connection's privacyLevelOptions, e.g. PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE, MUTUAL_FOLLOW_FRIENDS, FOLLOWER_OF_CREATOR, SELF_ONLY (defaults to SELF_ONLY)
params.disable_comment: Turn off comments on this post (optional, default false)
params.disable_duet: Turn off Duet for this post (optional, default false)
params.disable_stitch: Turn off Stitch for this post (optional, default false)
params.brand_content_toggle: Disclosure flag: the post is a paid partnership / branded content (optional, default false)
params.brand_organic_toggle: Disclosure flag: the post promotes the creator's own business (optional, default false)
